newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai shares end up despite crackdown.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai shares end up despite crackdown.

text.p: Shanghai shares closed sharply up on Friday despite Beijing's punishment of a number of major financial firms for illegal share trading.

Brokers said the news had been largely digested after weeks of swirling rumours. Institutional window-dressing buying aimed at stabilising the markets in the aftermath of the news was also a factor contributing to the rise,, they added.

The A share index gained 33.084 points or 2.61 percent to 1,298.922 on volume of 422.2 million shares worth 5.5 billion yuan. The B share index added 1.013 points or 1.22 percent to 83.931 on volume of 18.4 million shares worth $12.1 million.
